why: A script that passed --fresh to force a clean start got an instant exit 3 for each of 39 folders in the 2026-11-16 field run. --fresh asks for a run that starts from the beginning, which is what --apply always does: a check that moves files writes no progress file and is never continued. Refusing it protects nothing, so it is accepted and the run is exactly an --apply run: the fake font is moved, the exit is 2, and nothing is said about the flags (ADR-0071). --resume beside --apply stays refused; run.sh checks that.

findings.match: font file is not a font
